hook_style: Curiosity or sensory pattern interrupt within the first 1.5 seconds

structure.0-2s: High-impact visual hook + bold on-screen question
structure.2-10s: Sensory buildup showcasing craft, process, or exclusive deal
structure.10-15s: Climax and clear localized CTA (e.g. 'Tap link in bio to claim')

caption_rules: Max 3 punchy lines, warm narrative, 4-6 curated local hashtags, clear direct CTA.
